services.description: We combine content strategy, interface design, and technical implementation so your website is not only online, but actually works.

services.1.title: Landing page or company profile
services.1.description: A landing page or company profile that launches fast, looks convincing, and is ready to attract clients.
services.2.title: Information & operational system
services.2.description: Dashboards, portals, and internal systems to manage your data and day-to-day business operations.
services.3.title: Automation

process.description: Every phase has outputs you can see, test, and approve. You know exactly where the work is moving.
process.0.title: Needs audit
process.0.description: We map business goals, visual references, core features, and work priorities.
process.1.title: Design review

process.2.title: Development

process.3.description: The result is reviewed together, revised if needed, and tested until it is ready to go live.

services.0.long: A portfolio or personal CV website is your official home on the internet. Your profile, experience, and work are gathered neatly on one page that is easy to share with employers, clients, or universities.
services.0.detail.1: Gallery of selected work and projects
services.0.detail.3: Contact button and social media links
services.0.for: Fresh graduates, freelancers, creators, and professionals who want to look convincing.
services.1.long: A landing page or company profile helps a business make a good first impression. We shape the page flow, copy, and look so visitors quickly understand what you offer and feel encouraged to contact you.
services.1.detail.3: SEO setup so you are easy to find on Google
services.1.detail.4: Quick to launch once your materials are ready
services.1.for: Businesses, schools, cafes, communities, and companies that want a professional look.
services.2.long: An information system tidies up work that is currently scattered across spreadsheets, notes, and chats. Data lives in one place, can be accessed by role, and reports can be viewed anytime.
services.2.detail.0: A clean workflow that follows how you work
services.2.detail.4: An admin area to manage content yourself
services.2.for: Schools, institutions, shops, farms, and companies that want to manage data in a more organized way.
services.3.long: Repetitive tasks such as sending notifications, moving data between apps, or producing routine reports can run automatically. Your team saves time and avoids typing mistakes.
services.3.detail.0: Integration between the apps you already use
services.3.detail.1: Automatic notifications via WhatsApp or email
services.3.detail.4: Designed around the process you already run
services.3.for: Businesses and teams with a lot of repetitive manual work.
process.0.long: Before building anything, we want to understand your business: what the goal is, who the visitors are, and which features matter most. From there we set priorities so the work stays focused and avoids wasted cost.
process.0.do.0: Listening to your business goals and targets
process.0.do.1: Collecting the looks you like as references
process.0.do.2: Choosing the main features and the order of work
process.0.do.3: Explaining the estimated time and cost
process.0.you: Tell us your needs and share examples of websites you like.
process.0.result: A list of needs and priorities agreed together.
process.1.long: We lay out the page structure and a picture of the look first. You can review it and give feedback before building begins, so the final result stays close to what you imagined.
process.1.do.0: Planning the page structure and flow
process.1.do.1: Designing the look: colors, layout, and style
process.1.do.2: Explaining the design in plain language
process.1.do.3: Adjusting the design to your feedback
process.1.you: Review the design, then give feedback or approval.
process.1.result: A design agreed together before production starts.
process.2.long: Once the design is approved, the website, app, or automation gets built. It is responsive on phones and computers, and you can share feedback while the work is in progress.
process.2.do.0: Building pages and features from the design
process.2.do.1: Making sure it looks right on phones, tablets, and computers
process.2.do.2: Setting up the basics to be easy to find on Google
process.2.you: Prepare texts, photos, and logos, and share feedback when you have any.
process.2.result: A first version you can try out. A simple website is usually done within 1–3 working days once materials are ready.
process.3.long: We try the result together. Anything that is not quite right gets revised, then everything is tested again until it works well on different devices and is ready to go live.
process.3.do.0: Checking the look on different screen sizes
process.3.do.3: Making sure everything is ready to launch
process.3.you: Try the result and tell us what you would like adjusted.
process.3.result: A tested product that you have approved.
process.4.long: The product is published and open to everyone. We set it up to be easy to find on Google, then hand over access together with a usage guide so you can manage it comfortably.
process.4.do.2: Handing over access and a usage guide
process.4.do.3: Supporting you with 1 year of free maintenance, plus a domain (Small package) or hosting (Large package)
process.4.you: Keep your access safe and start sharing it with your customers.
process.4.result: The website or app is live and ready to use.

faq.title: Questions that usually come up before starting.
faq.description: If your question has not been answered here, a consultation session can help determine your needs.
faq.0.question: What services can Nocoding create?
faq.0.answer: We create personal portfolio or CV websites, landing pages or company profiles, information and operational systems, and business process automation.
faq.1.question: How long does the development process take?
faq.1.answer: A personal portfolio, CV, or simple landing page usually takes 1-3 working days after the materials are ready. Larger projects depend on feature needs, integrations, and feedback rhythm.
faq.2.question: Can the design and features be customized?
faq.2.answer: Yes. The design, page structure, features, and workflow can be tailored to your needs. The design will be reviewed together before development begins.
faq.3.question: What is included in the pricing?
faq.3.answer: The Small package starts at IDR 500K and the Big package at IDR 2M per year; the final amount is agreed after a free consultation on WhatsApp. The price covers the work in the agreed package and scope. The Small package includes free maintenance and a domain for 1 year, and the Big package includes free maintenance and hosting for 1 year.
contact.title: Tell us your website needs. We will help clean up the path.
contact.description: Send a short overview of your business, target pages, and desired timeline. The first reply will include scope recommendations and next steps. Consultations are always free, whenever you need one.

project.description.ecoswap: An online marketplace for buying and selling used items. People can list, browse, and buy easily from a phone or computer.
project.description.wiboost: An online store for digital services such as game top-ups, data packages, and premium apps, with customer balances and a reseller program.
project.description.ahawi: A personal portfolio website in a watercolor painting style with two languages, to introduce a profile, experience, and contact details.
project.description.abdi: A records system for the palace servants (abdi dalem) of the Surakarta Keraton: registration, personal data, activity schedules, attendance, and ID card printing.
project.description.sfarm: An app to manage a village-owned egg-laying chicken and goat farm: daily records, sales, expenses, and financial reports.
project.description.payu: A platform that connects people who post tasks with freelancers. Task posters offer a reward, freelancers complete the work, and payment is made via QRIS.
project.description.darcasual: An online catalog with over a thousand products. Shoppers can search, filter, and order directly through WhatsApp.
project.description.ianprem: An online store for premium app accounts such as Netflix and Spotify. Buyers choose and pay on their own, while admins manage stock and sales.
project.description.alengka: An online catalog of indoor and outdoor furniture for cafes, restaurants, and homes. Visitors can browse the collection and consult via WhatsApp.
project.description.sdn: The official website of an elementary school with a school profile, new student admission info, teacher list, extracurriculars, and student achievements.
project.description.furnix: An online catalog of iron furniture from Jepara for cafes, restaurants, and homes. Visitors can pick products and order to their own preferences.
project.description.clothique: A complete online clothing store: catalog, shopping cart, online payment, blog, and an admin area to manage orders and reports.
project.description.agli: A tool for content teams to collect the most-viewed content examples, spot the patterns, and draft new posts.
project.description.nebulist: An AI-powered sales helper that creates a strategy, prospect notes, and outreach message drafts from product information.
project.description.carbonfi: A digital finance app for trading carbon credits (rewards for cutting emissions) and eco-friendly reward programs.
project.description.protectedpay: A safe digital money transfer app: funds are released only once received, with group payments and savings.
project.description.pedulichain: A transparent donation platform: every donation and how the funds are used is permanently recorded and visible to anyone.
project.description.astra: An AI assistant you can simply chat with to manage digital assets, such as sending tokens or creating digital collectibles, with no coding knowledge.
project.description.auditfi: An AI-based security checker for digital finance programs that finds weak spots and writes a report in seconds.
project.description.p2p: A platform for swapping digital assets directly between users, with transaction protection and an admin area to run the platform.
project.description.payguppy: An app that helps ordinary shops accept digital currency payments using the QR codes they already have.
project.description.tiptap: A platform for content creators to receive tips from viewers in digital money or digital collectibles, with alerts during live streams.
project.description.senkus: A science and alchemy themed online game: players combine potions, collect digital items, and compete in an arena.
project.description.quickstock: A computer app for managing the stock of a clothing store: record sales, supplier deliveries, and stock reports, with access based on each employee role.
project.description.caer: A platform for lending and borrowing digital assets across networks with support for the IDRX digital rupiah, making it easy to save and borrow.
